verdict.rationale: The pack documents greenfield IaC only: CloudFormation provisions resources from templates, and CDK deploys through CloudFormation. Nothing in it describes importing existing resources into stacks or detecting drift. The axis clearly applies to a cloud platform with first-party IaC, so missing evidence yields none, not na.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, existing resources can come under IaC — documented import/drift workflows instead of a greenfield-only story
